Job Description

At IPS, you will apply your knowledge, skills, and passion to make a difference in the lives of people, solving complex challenges related to pharmaceutical, biotech, and animal health research and manufacturing facilities. We are looking for a talented Senior Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineer to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.


In this role, you will work independently on various projects as assigned by a Project Manager or group leader. You will also play a role in the entire design process including but not limited to preliminary assessments, concept creation, design, problem resolution, and customer and vendor accessibility. Additionally, you may work on several concurrent projects and at times may assist as a technical expert on a specialized design. Fluency in English is mandatory
What You'll Do

  • Assign and review the work of the project design team.
  • Check the progress of work and alert the Project Manager to changes in scope or additional services.
  • Attend pre-bid meetings and assist the project team in evaluating commercial proposals.
  • Assess the requirements of a project, break a project into tasks, and work with a Project Manager to determine the scope of work, budget, and staffing.
  • Write the scope of work for plumbing and fire protection designs based on preliminary reviews and meetings with the clients.
  • Develop design concepts and prepare documents during the design development phase.
  • Correct and update design documents.
  • Develops solutions to design problems.
  • Prepare engineering studies and schematic designs for new systems and analyze the operation of existing systems.
  • Use computer-aided design technologies to develop sketches, drawings, and construction documents.
  • Review drawings and documents to ensure compliance with company design and production standards.
  • Work with equipment suppliers/vendors to obtain the necessary information needed for design completion.
  • Interacts with clients regularly to secure scope and design intent.
  • Ensure acceptable levels of quality and check for coordination of work to ensure documents reflect design intent and necessary coordination.
  • Coordinate all aspects of project document completion within the company and externally with clients and other design professionals.
  • Coordinate design work with related engineering disciplines.
  • Attend job and construction meetings and participate in the coordination of the work.
  • Contribute to annual performance reviews for assigned staff.
  • Assist in the education and development of design staff and act as a resource for design questions.

Come join a caring, nimble team that delivers world-class designs for our pharmaceutical clients and take your career to new heights!


Qualifications & Requirements
  • 10+ years of previous Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineering and Design experience.
  • Bachelor of Engineering Degree from an accredited University.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE).
  • Has previous experience working for an Architectural and Engineering firm (A&E).
  • Is proficient in the use of computers for design and understands CAD operations.
  • Has knowledge of all aspects of plumbing and fire protection systems; including Sanitary and Vent Systems, Storm Systems, Process Waste Systems, Lab and Vent Systems, Domestic Water Systems, Process and Lab Gas Systems, Sprinkler Design, and Wet/Dry/Pre Action Systems.
  • Is able to produce calculations for the above systems.
  • Has a demonstrated ability to manage projects, problem solve, and communicate effectively to all key personnel and time manage.
  • Able to travel up to 25%.
  • Must have more than 5 years’ experience in pharmaceutical projects
  • Must be fluent in English
  • Must have experience in Revit, AutoCad plant 3D

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in process industries, particularly in the Life Sciences sector (pharmaceutical, biotech, or similar).
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) to support teams in Brazil and the USA.
  • Strong understanding of international codes and standards (e.g., ASME, ANSI, NFPA).

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. IPS, inclusive of its Enterprise entities, has over 3,500 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East. title: Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)
description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple:design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’sthe way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist
description:
Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled licensed CLS to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience in running Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) and knowledge of molecular biology techniques.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that the equipment is calibrated, maintained, and operated according to the manufacturer's guidelines and standard operating procedures.
  • Adheres to the CAP, CLIA and NYS regulations.
  • Run protocols for sample collection, processing, storage, and tracking in LIMs to ensure the integrity and traceability of the samples throughout the NGS workflow.
  • Run clinical and R&D samples for NGS and molecular biology techniques, including microdissection, FFPE nucleic acid extraction, NGS library preparation, sequencing, data analysis, and quality control measures with appropriate NGS controls.
  • Perform and train other CLS’s on established NGS and molecular biology procedures, including macrodissection, FFPE nucleic acid extraction, NGS library preparation, sequencing, and data analysis, including quality control measures.
  • Perform validation testing to ensure with selected reagents and controls to ensure the assay meets the required performance specifications.
  • Perform validation studies to assess the performance characteristics of the NGS assay, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, precision, and reproducibility.
  • Analyze and interpret data using appropriate statistical methods and software, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, precision and reproducibility.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation of experiments and results.
The above list represents the general duties considered essential functions of the job and is not to be considered an exhaustive description of all the work requirements that may be inherent in the position.

Requirements

  • Minimum 4 years as a certified or licensed clinical laboratory scientist
  • California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (Highly Preferred: California Clinical Genetic Molecular Biologist Scientist license - CGMBS.)
  • Must be well-organized, open-minded, decisive, and flexible. They must be able to communicate well with others, and work as a team. Good writing skills and and extensive computer experience are necessary
  • Experience with Macrodissection, RNA extraction and downstream analysis
  • Strong experience in development of targeted library, conducting sequencing NGS library preparation, sequencing, and data analysis
  • Experience in project management and organization
  • Excellent record-keeping and documentation skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team-oriented environment
  • Validation and SOP writing experience a plus
  • Must have superior work ethic, driven and be results oriented
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Preferred Bachelor's or Master's degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or related field
  • Anatomic or Clinical Pathology experience
  • Prior experience with NextGen sequencing instruments.
  • Minimum of 4 years of molecular and histology experience within an anatomic pathology laboratory or clinical laboratory.

  • Questiona premissas, busca hipóteses alternativas e aprofunda-se até a causa raiz dos problemas.

  • Vivência com sistemas de recomendação, ranking ou personalização em tempo real

Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas de refrigeração, zelando pela guarda, conservação, manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais utilizados, bem como do local de trabalho, garantindo o correto descarte de resíduos de materiais do local de trabalho.


Main responsibilities

  • Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas de refrigeração, zelando pela guarda, conservação, manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais utilizados, bem como do local de trabalho.
  • Executar, sob orientação, atividades de instalação e manutenção corretiva e preventiva de equipamentos, válvulas e dispositivos de sistemas e conjuntos de refrigeração.
  • Efetuar, sob orientação, a manutenção, conserto, reparos e reformas em válvulas, tubulações, sistemas de ventilação, calefação e ar condicionado, medidores e outros dispositivos de sistemas de refrigeração.
  • Ler, interpretar e utilizar manuais, catálogos, tabelas e especificações técnicas, bem como ferramental e equipamentos específicos e especializados para execução dos serviços de refrigeração.
  • Fazer a instalação dos sistemas de refrigeração e auxiliares, em função de sua experiência e especialidade, bem como realizar reparos e ajustes nos motores destes sistemas.
  • Auxiliar em estudos e análises de funcionamento dos equipamentos de refrigeração, a fim de solucionar problemas de funcionamento.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e instalação de ar-condicionado em toda planta industrial.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva do sistema de refrigeração, ventilação e tubulações.
  • Auxiliar e executar, sob supervisão, em caso de adequações necessárias para o perfeito funcionamento dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo o correto descarte de resíduos de materiais do local de trabalho.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios das atividades realizadas pelo Plano de Manutenção Operação e Controle (PMOC).
  • Executar outras atividades inerentes ao cargo, conforme solicitação do superior imediato
  • Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente do trabalho, estabelecidos pela organização, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs de uso obrigatório no desenvolvimento das atividades do cargo e do setor. Tendo a tresponsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho.
  • Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e processos da empresa, sempre focando nas metas organizacionais, e mantendo sigilo e protegendo as informações da companhia.
  • Manter a disciplina no programa 5S, objetivando um trabalho seguro por meio da manutenção da organização, padronização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Zelar pelas propriedades da empresa sob sua responsabilidade, informando ao superior imediato qualquer problema ou avaria detectada.

Experiência na função.

title: Business Development Lead
description:
Company Description

Traditional Trade Reinvention, or TTR, responds to the modernization NielsenIQ is seeking and that our clients have been asking for. It starts with the transformation of how we collect data from Independent stores around the globe, transforming the data collection to digital and POS input.

Job Description

This role is responsible for active searching for, connecting with and negotiating the collaboration agreement with different POS Software companies, Data aggregators, Data extractors to acquire POS Tlog data from Independent Trade stores. The role can cover multiple countries, depending on the digitization strategy and needs.

About you

Strong acumen in business development, SMB business. The person should be resourceful, results-driven, understanding the basics of the POS Software & Hardware capabilities, competent in building vendor relationship which might even start with desktop research. Passionate about new POS technologies in SMB business within independent trade and finding opportunities to connect the technology with NIQ data sourcing needs. The person needs to have excellent negotiation skills, understanding of legal affairs/contract negotiations with sharp financial acumen.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Data Strategy team & regional Product Leads to understand product road map and ensure vendor sourcing plans are in sync
  • Work with Data Strategy Team & regional Product Leads on channel level plans and ensure alignment on targeted # of stores & channel types for the country’s vendor needs
  • Creating sourcing plan on country and channel type level
  • Ongoing lead generation of POS providers, Data Aggregators, Promo companies & other eData providers through- RES, desk research, referrals, networking
  • Establish contact with the right person within these companies with data partnership decision making powers
  • Pitch NIQ eData vision and plans, initiate further discussions with these companies
  • Ensuring legal documentation is in place to enable further discussions (NDA)
  • Facilitate further discussions with vendor through stages of :
    • establishing store count estimates,
    • ensuring testing data are received in a proper format
    • providing feedback to the vendor based on the test data
    • aligning final usable store counts
  • Drive discussions with Data Strategy team to craft a lucrative offering for the vendor, negotiate the deal, business case approval & contracts
  • Ensure smooth handover of vendor to eData & internal teams post contract for technical elements of the vendor relationship
  • Identify vendors with scope of partnering & expanding footprint within & across countries
  • Work with Global Data Partnership teams to create expansion plans, offering & investment asks
  • Negotiate the expansion deals & ensure execution
  • Participate in Retailer & Retail Tech events to showcase NielsenIQ eData vision
  • Launch Social Media campaigns to showcase NielsenIQ eData vision
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of experience in commercial (sales or customer service)
  • Ideally from FMCG or Retail background, if not then 2nd choice will be Retail Tech
  • Great communication skills, out of box thinker, creative in establishing contact with POS SW companies, Data Aggregators
  • Operates independently, while knowing when & how to escalate for support
  • Operates well with stakeholders across functions. Is a great team player
  • Excellent presentation skills, sales pitching, contract and deal negotiations
  • Great account management skills, identifying opportunities to grow the business with the collaborating vendor
  • Is confident working with senior leadership
  • Working well in a dynamic team, but also thriving in individual work
Additional Information

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View. title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades

  • Fazer a gestão de toda a equipe de segurança e time orgânico (supervisores cftv e bombeiros civis);
  • Assegurar toda a estratégia da segurança patrimonial do shopping;
  • Fazer a gestão da brigada de incêndio (fiscalização de lojas, áreas técnicas e mall, atendimento a clientes, etc);
  • Garantir o registro e análise das ocorrências e situações de risco;
  • Gerir os contratos das empresas terceirizadas (segurança, brigada de incêndio, etc);
  • Garantir a realização dos treinamentos das equipes de vigilantes e brigada de incêndio junto às equipes terceirizadas quanto a gestão de crise e plano de emergência;
  • Controlar as documentações legais e licenças de responsabilidade da área de segurança e brigada de incêndio (AVCB);
  • Garantir bom relacionamento com órgãos de segurança pública, polícia militar, civil, bombeiros;
  • Gestão dos indicadores da área: vistorias nas lojas de alimentação, programa de excelência e auditoria anual de segurança;
  • Gestão orçamentária de toda equipe de segurança e brigada;
  • Gestão das não conformidades relacionadas a segurança das lojas, eventos e quiosques;
  • Controle de ponto de toda equipe orgânica de segurança e brigada.

Requisitos

  • Desejável Experiência em Shopping Center;
  • Experiência em segurança patrimonial;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipe orgânica e terceiros;
  • Conhecimentos da legislação de segurança patrimonial e brigada;

Esta pessoa terá um papel relevante na aplicação de machine learning e inteligência artificial, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares para transformar dados em soluções acionáveis e de alto valor para o negócio. A posição está aberta para profissionais com diferentes níveis de experiência, desde quem está iniciando na área até quem já possui trajetória consolidada.

  • Integrar ou liderar projetos de ciência de dados, desde a identificação de problemas de negócios até a entrega de soluções analíticas que gerem impacto mensurável.
  • Criar, implementar e manter modelos preditivos e soluções de machine learning, utilizando grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias, fornecendo insights estratégicos e recomendações baseadas em dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão.
  • Colaborar com equipes de engenharia de dados, produto e negócios para integrar modelos e algoritmos aos sistemas e fluxos operacionais.
  • Pesquisar e implementar novas técnicas, ferramentas e frameworks em machine learning e inteligência artificial, acompanhando tendências de mercado e tecnologia.
  • Compartilhar boas práticas com o time, promovendo uma cultura de excelência técnica e colaboração.
  • Garantir que as soluções entregues sejam escaláveis, interpretáveis e alinhadas às melhores práticas de ciência de dados e engenharia.
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho dos modelos implementados, propondo melhorias contínuas.

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Programação em Python ou R.
  • Bibliotecas e frameworks de análise e modelagem de dados (ex.: Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Fundamentos de estatística, probabilidade e modelagem preditiva.
  • Manipulação de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e/ou não relacionais.
  • Ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência prática com Deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção.
  • Vivência com ambientes de computação em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de MLOps.
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos de ciência de dados aplicados ao negócio.
Perfil profissional:
  • Visão analítica e foco em resultados.
  • Curiosidade intelectual e disposição para explorar novas abordagens e tecnologias.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, colaborar com diferentes áreas e comunicar soluções técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade, organização e autonomia para conduzir projetos.
  • Facilidade para lidar com desafios complexos, propondo soluções criativas e práticas.

  • Otimização da Operação de Limpeza e Cozinha: Gerir a operação interna de limpeza e cozinha com um olhar crítico para a eficiência e a qualidade. Supervisionar a execução dos contratos de fornecedores, garantindo que os padrões de higiene, organização e produtividade sejam consistentemente mantidos, de acordo com as necessidades e expectativas do ambiente corporativo.
  • Gestão Executiva da Cozinha: Ser o responsável pelo processo operacional da cozinha, garantindo a eficiência, o alinhamento às normas técnicas e a melhoria contínua dos serviços. Implementar e auditar rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança alimentar e boas práticas, assegurando um serviço de alta qualidade e conformidade.
  • Excelência em Hospitalidade: Assegurar que o ambiente de trabalho seja não apenas acolhedor, mas também um catalisador de engajamento e produtividade.   • Planejamento e Execução de Obras com Visão Estratégica: Coordenar o planejamento e a execução de obras e reformas, desde a concepção até a entrega, garantindo que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo, orçamento e conforme as exigências estabelecidas. Aplicar uma visão executiva para antecipar necessidades futuras de infraestrutura e otimizar o uso dos espaços.
  • Compliance e Conformidade Regulatória: Garantir que todos os espaços estejam em conformidade com as normas de acessibilidade, segurança, ergonomia e saúde ocupacional, incluindo a adequação às normas de segurança e boas práticas de alimentação. Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as legislações pertinentes.

Realizar o controle financeiro de todos os projetos e despesas da área, apresentando relatórios claros e insights para a tomada de decisão.
  • Cultura e Engajamento Contínuo: Atuar como um(a) embaixador(a) da cultura do Jusbrasil, apoiando na implementação de iniciativas que promovam o bem-estar, o reconhecimento e a motivação dos colaboradores. Colaborar ativamente com o time de People e outros stakeholders para garantir um ambiente alinhado com a cultura organizacional e que estimule a performance.
  • Sustentabilidade e Inovação: Implementar e disseminar práticas sustentáveis dentro do ambiente de trabalho, buscando soluções inovadoras que contribuam para as metas de responsabilidade social e ambiental da empresa.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de facilities, com histórico de liderança de times e de projetos de transformação e otimização de processos.
  • Profundo conhecimento técnico e operacional de todos os fluxos e processos de facilities, com capacidade de "colocar a mão na massa" e resolver desafios operacionais.
  • Visão executiva e estratégica, com habilidade para planejar a longo prazo, antecipar necessidades de infraestrutura e propor soluções inovadoras que impactem positivamente a performance da empresa.
  • Conhecimento sólido em normas técnicas como NBR 9050 (2020), NBR 9077 (2021), NR 23 (2022), NR 24 (2019), NR 17, e outras regulamentações de segurança e ergonomia.
  • Sólida experiência em gerenciamento de contratos, negociação com fornecedores e gestão de relacionamento com prestadores de serviço.
  • Experiência robusta com planejamento, gestão e execução de obras e reformas, incluindo controle de cronograma, qualidade e orçamento.
  • Habilidade avançada em gestão de orçamento, controle de custos e análise de indicadores de performance.
  • Capacidade de liderança inspiradora e comprovada experiência em construir, desenvolver e motivar equipes multifuncionais, impulsionando a alta performance e a mudança cultural.
  • Conhecimento e vivência com ferramentas de gestão de facilities e software de planejamento.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, construindo relacionamentos sólidos e eficazes.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Lean Six Sigma ou outras metodologias de melhoria contínua.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em sustentabilidade e práticas de economia circular aplicadas a ambientes corporativos.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão no Jusbrasil

Somos uma empresa que se preocupa em oferecer oportunidades iguais de crescimento a todos os nossos colaboradores, e que busca cada vez mais aumentar internamente a presença de grupos sub-representados, como mulheres, pessoas negras, pessoas da comunidade LGBTQIA+ e PCDs. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências são essenciais para um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, respeitoso e de alto impacto na sociedade, e temos orgulho em dizer que o Jusbrasil toma iniciativas internas e externas de fomento à Diversidade & Inclusão.

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma equipe centrada no cuidado, que busca ser a diferença na vida das pessoas? E melhor ainda, estar dentro do maior sistema de cooperativas de saúde do mundo?

Venha fazer parte de nossa equipe!

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa que faz a diferença no cuidar das pessoas? Então aqui é o seu lugar!

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
description:
Recruitment at TRACTIAN
Great companies are built by great people, and at TRACTIAN, we embody this philosophy. Our Recruitment team thrives on the principles of Blue Cap, Transparency, and Brio/Empuje/Grit. We cultivate a culture where every individual is their own master, leading by example and driving others to excellence. Our transparent communication is the bedrock of our operations, ensuring everyone takes ownership of their work with the integrity to swiftly acknowledge and learn from mistakes. We tackle daunting challenges with a can-do attitude, breaking down complex tasks into achievable actions, and pushing forward with vigor and tenacity. Joining TRACTIAN means being part of an ecosystem where your zeal for innovation, dedication to growth, and relentless pursuit of excellence are the fuel that propels us to the forefront of our industry.
What you'll do
As a Senior Sales Recruiter, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and recruiting top-tier sales professionals to join our high-performing team. Your primary focus will be on sourcing, engaging, and assessing candidates who have a proven track record in sales excellence. You will leverage your industry expertise and network to attract candidates who can drive revenue growth and exceed sales targets.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify and target top sales talent.
  • Utilize advanced sourcing techniques, including social media, networking events, and industry databases, to build a strong pipeline of candidates.
  • Conduct thorough interviews and assessments to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit.
  • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their specific needs and develop tailored recruitment strategies.
  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, from initial contact through offer negotiation and onboarding.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • +3 years of experience in sales recruitment, with a strong track record of placing high-performing sales professionals.
  • Deep understanding of sales methodologies, metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with candidates and stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in using recruitment software and applicant tracking systems (ATS).

Bonus Points

  • Experience in recruiting for SaaS or HaaS companies.
  • Proven ability to recruit for senior-level and niche sales roles.

title: Product Manager
description:
At PPRO, our mission is to simplify access to local payment methods and our vision is to enable the sale of goods and services to anyone in the world using their preferred way to pay. We empower partners such as Ant Group, PayPal and Stripe to access new markets, connect with more customers, and accelerate their growth.

Our strength lies in our diverse global team with 50+ nationalities and 10+ international locations- all united around one goal – to deliver the best possible products and services to our partners and customers. While our company mission is to keep innovating global commerce, our internal mission is to #chooseaction, #beopen, #thinkcustomer, #gofurther and #wintogether

The Purpose:

The Cash Account team, part of PPRO’s Cash Flow domain, builds technologies that keeps our customers happy by simplifying and standardizing their cash movement through our banking network as well as offering new values as they grow their business whilst strengthening the relationship with our bank partners. We ultimately aim to unify our customers’ journey of their cash movement across all regions by absorbing all the complexity and offering standardized services and reporting.


What You Will Be Doing
  • Define and Lead Strategy:

Develop and communicate clear product statements and requirements for cash account aligning with PPRO’s business goals.

Own and evolve the cash account product portfolio, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and a strong value proposition for customers.

  • Innovate and Build Market-Leading Products:

Design and develop innovative cash account solutions that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

Improve automation and accuracy, reducing manual operations efforts for customers.

  • Drive Operational Excellence:

Own a multi-quarter roadmap, breaking down complex initiatives into shippable features that align with business priorities.

Define and track key product metrics to continuously improve banking performance and customer satisfaction.

Work closely with engineering to ensure technical feasibility and timely execution.

  • Enhance Stakeholder Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams, including Treasury, Compliance, Finance, and Customer Support, to ensure seamless cash account processes.

Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, gathering insights and ensuring alignment.

  • Build and Foster a High-Performing Team:

Collaborate closely with engineering and domain leadership to accelerate product innovation.

Champion a customer-centric mindset within the team, driving meaningful and impactful solutions.

What Success Looks Like
  • A scalable and efficient cash account platform that simplifies cost transparency and banking onboarding for customers.
  • Reduced manual treasury operations through automation, leading to improved accuracy and efficiency.
  • Strong alignment between product, engineering, and key stakeholders to accelerate development and innovation.
  • A high-performing, customer-focused team that delivers consistent results.
What We Are Looking For
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global environment.
  • Strong ability to define and execute product strategy, balancing long-term mission with immediate business needs.
  • Deep understanding of customer pain points and a passion for solving complex banking challenges.
  • Experience in running product discovery and defining success metrics to measure impact.
  • Experience in payments, banking, or financial technology, with a deep understanding of banking models and operations.
  • Strong ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements for engineering teams.
  • Expertise in leveraging data insights to optimize product performance.
  • Ability to create and track product metrics, ensuring continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Ability to influence and inspire teams, drive collaboration, and generate buy-in for product initiatives.
  • Proven track record of working closely with engineering, finance, and operational teams to deliver impactful solutions.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Deep technical knowledge with experience working across multiple engineering teams.
  • Prior experience in banking, treasury operations, pricing models, or payout systems.
  • Strong analytical skills to size opportunities and measure product impact effectively.

What we offer:

Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.

Learning and Development - We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.

Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including life insurance, health insurance + dental plan and travel insurance.

Meal vouchers - BRL 54/ day - Enjoy a moment of conviviality and a good and balanced meal thanks to your meal vouchers. You will also have the choice between meal allowance, supermarket voucher or both (splitting the total value in two)

Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.

Gym membership - PPRO helpscontribute towardsthe costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet

New Value (Deals & Coupon Platform) - Get attractive discounts to restaurants, stores and events

SESC - private institution that makes available Education, Health, Culture and Recreational programs and events and provides Social Assistance to our employees and their dependents.

title: Product Manager
description:
Job description

Se você é da turma que adora criar produtos que fazem a diferença, vibra quando vê um impacto real no negócio e não tem medo de colocar a mão na massa (com IA, dados e tudo que estiver à disposição) — vem com a gente!

Aqui na Suno, estamos em busca de um(a)Product Manager com espírito de dono e paixão por resolver problemas. Alguém que tenha foco total no impacto para o negócio, mas que também valorize boas práticas, tecnologia e uma experiência incrível pro usuário.

Somos uma empresa em constante movimento — crescer, testar, aprender rápido, mudar quando necessário, sem medo de errar (desde que a gente erre rápido e com responsabilidade!).

Se você gosta de ambiente dinâmico, autonomia de verdade e espaço pra colocar suas ideias em prática, essa vaga pode ser pra você.


Main responsibilities

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia:

  • Cocriação de soluções com foco em impacto real, lado a lado com o time de tecnologia e stakeholders.
  • Usar IA e ferramentas modernas (no-code, low-code...) pra acelerar entregas e evitar complexidade desnecessária.
  • Priorizar eficiência e entregas incrementais — aqui, o foco é no que realmente gera valor pro negócio e pro cliente.
  • Tomar decisões técnicas com base em impacto (não em preferência pessoal ou stack fixa).
  • Ser o elo entre produto, tecnologia e áreas de negócio, garantindo fluidez e colaboração.
  • Ajudar a manter o ambiente de trabalho produtivo e saudável: boas práticas, automações e qualidade nas entregas.
  • Garantir comunicação contínua com o time e stakeholders, com total visibilidade do que está sendo feito.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Alta capacidade de comunicação: você vai participar ativamente das discussões e precisa manter o time alinhado e engajado.
  • Protagonismo e ownership: aqui, a gente valoriza quem assume e resolve, com autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Mentalidade inconformada e orientada à entrega: nada de “é assim que sempre foi”. Por aqui, queremos gente que questione, busque o melhor caminho e gere impacto real.
  • Abertura ao novo: testar, aprender e incorporar novas tecnologias faz parte do dia a dia (sim, IA também!).
  • Colaboração real: você será ponte entre diferentes áreas — sucesso do produto aqui é trabalho em equipe.
  • Capacidade de julgamento técnico de negócio: saber quando simplificar é tão importante quanto saber quando investir em uma solução mais robusta.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com entregas rápidas e impactantes (MVPs, protótipos, experimentos...).
  • Familiaridade com IA (ex: ChatGPT, Lovable, N8N...).
  • Boa visão de tecnologia e produtos digitais — não precisa ser dev, mas tem que entender bem o que é viável e o que gera valor.
  • Postura protagonista e alta capacidade de organização em ambiente dinâmico.

Vai se destacar se tiver:

  • Participação em projetos com foco em IA aplicada.
  • Histórico de atuação próxima a produto, marketing e/ou dados.
  • Forte capacidade de navegação em ambiente de mudança e crescimento acelerado.

Additional information

O que você ganha jogando no nosso time:

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, pra cuidar bem de você.
  • Seguro de vida, porque segurança também é qualidade de vida.
  • Desconto no Wellhub (Gympass) e no Zenklub — corpo e mente em dia!
  • Parcerias institucionais que dão aquela força extra em cursos, serviços e mais.
  • PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados) — aqui todo mundo cresce junto.
  • Um Day Off no seu aniversário, porque seu dia merece ser só seu!
  • Acesso à assinatura Suno Black (pra você e familiares de 1º grau!).
  • Assinatura do Plano Bull - Status Invest — pra você mergulhar no mundo dos investimentos com profundidade e inteligência.

Se você se identifica com um ambiente que valoriza inovação, responsabilidade e entrega de verdade, e quer ajudar a construir produtos que transformam o mercado — seu lugar pode ser aqui!

title: Senior AdministrativeAssistant
description:
Job Description

Na IPS, somos líderes globais no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras para consultoria, arquitetura, engenharia, controles de projetos, aquisição, gerenciamento de construção e CQV de instalações tecnicamente complexas, principalmente no setor de ciências biológicas. Estamos procurando um Assistente Administrativo Sênior dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe em nosso escritório localizado em São Paulo, Brasil.

Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas no setor de engenharia, atuando no suporte direto a equipes técnicas, projetos multidisciplinares e áreas corporativas. Inglês fluente para comunicação com stakeholders internacionais, leitura de documentação técnica e suporte a relatórios e apresentações em língua inglesa.
Principais Atribuições:

  • Atender e direcionar chamadas telefônicas, e-mails e correspondências, com postura profissional e fluência em inglês, garantindo comunicação eficiente com clientes, fornecedores e parceiros nacionais e internacionais.
  • Recepcionar visitantes, fornecedores e equipes externas, oferecendo suporte logístico e administrativo a colaboradores internos e engenheiros.
  • Gerenciar o controle de suprimentos de escritório, materiais técnicos e equipamentos, atuando preventivamente na reposição e organização de estoques.
  • Manter áreas comuns organizadas, coordenando os materiais de escritório e limpeza para bom funcionamento da estrutura de apoio.
  • Criar, atualizar e manter bancos de dados administrativos e técnicos, sistemas de arquivamento (físico e digital), relatórios, registros e documentos de projeto.
  • Utilizar com domínio ferramentas como Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), além de sistemas corporativos como Ariba, Concur e SAP, aplicados à rotina de projetos de engenharia.
  • Apoiar ações de comunicação interna e institucional, incluindo apresentações, materiais de divulgação e eventos corporativos, com atenção à identidade visual e linguagem técnica.
  • Organizar viagens técnicas, visitas a obras e eventos externos, bem como gerenciar processos de reembolso e prestação de contas de despesas.
  • Prestar suporte na elaboração, revisão e formatação de propostas técnicas e comerciais, em português e inglês, garantindo conformidade com os padrões da empresa.
  • Auxiliar na gestão de contratos (clientes e fornecedores), controle de faturas, ordens de compra, notas fiscais e documentos administrativos vinculados a projetos de engenharia.
  • Participar de reuniões de projeto, elaborando atas detalhadas, acompanhando pendências e contribuindo com o fluxo de informações entre áreas técnicas e administrativas.
  • Coordenar a logística e estrutura de eventos internos, treinamentos e reuniões com stakeholders, internos e externos.
    Atribuições Complementares:
  • Apoiar a gestão de contratos com fornecedores técnicos e prestadores de serviço, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, escopos e condições contratuais.
  • Atuar no controle e apresentação de indicadores administrativos e operacionais relacionados a projetos e desempenho da área.
  • Colaborar na implementação e atualização de processos internos, fluxos administrativos e políticas da qualidade.
  • Servir como elo entre os times técnicos (engenharia, projetos, produção) e as áreas de apoio (financeiro, compras, RH, jurídico), facilitando a integração das atividades.
  • Conduzir o processo de onboarding de novos colaboradores, especialmente estagiários e engenheiros juniores, apoiando na logística de integração e acesso a ferramentas corporativas.
  • Garantir a confidencialidade, organização e rastreabilidade de todos os documentos sob sua responsabilidade, com foco em compliance e boas práticas de gestão da informação.

At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Administrative Assistant to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle and direct phone calls, emails, and correspondence professionally and in fluent English, ensuring efficient communication with clients, suppliers, and national and international partners.
  • Welcome visitors, suppliers, and external teams, providing logistical and administrative support to internal staff and engineers.
  • Manage the control of office supplies, technical materials, and equipment, ensuring timely restocking and organized inventory.
  • Maintain organized common areas and coordinate the supply of office and cleaning materials to support operational routines.
  • Create, update, and maintain administrative and technical databases, physical and digital filing systems, reports, records, and project documentation.
  • Proficiently use Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as corporate systems such as Ariba, Concur, and SAP, in support of engineering project routines.
  • Support internal and institutional communication activities, including presentations, marketing materials, and corporate events, while adhering to branding and technical standards.
  • Organize business travel, technical visits to construction sites, and external events, as well as manage reimbursement and expense reporting processes.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and formatting of technical and commercial proposals in both Portuguese and English, ensuring compliance with company standards.
  • Support contract management (clients and suppliers), invoice control, purchase orders, and administrative documents related to engineering projects.
  • Participate in project meetings by drafting detailed minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating communication between technical and administrative teams.
  • Coordinate logistics and structure for internal events, training sessions, and meetings with internal and external stakeholder

    Additional Responsibilities:
  • Support the management of contracts with technical suppliers and service providers, ensuring compliance with deadlines, scopes, and contractual terms.
  • Assist in controlling and presenting administrative and operational indicators related to projects and departmental performance.
  • Collaborate in the implementation and continuous improvement of internal processes, administrative workflows, and quality policies.
  • Serve as a link between technical teams (engineering, projects, production) and support departments (finance, procurement, HR, legal), promoting integration and workflow efficiency.
  • Manage the onboarding process for new employees, especially interns and junior engineers, by organizing logistics, documentation, and access to corporate tools.
  • Ensure the confidentiality, organization, and traceability of all documents under your responsibility, with a focus on compliance and best practices in information management.

Only candidates who meet the qualifications outlined in the job description will be considered by IPS.


Qualifications & Requirements
  • Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas no setor de engenharia, atuando no suporte direto a equipes
  • técnicas, projetos multidisciplinares e áreas corporativas.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação com stakeholders internacionais, leitura de documentação técnica e suporte a relatórios e apresentações em língua inglesa
  • Professional with over 10 years of experience in administrative routines within the engineering sector, providing direct support to technical teams,
  • multidisciplinary projects, and corporate departments.
  • Fluent in English, capable of handling communication with international stakeholders, understanding technical documentation, and supporting the preparation of reports and presentations in English.

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway Company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. Its newest acquisition, Linesight, specializes in cost, schedule, risk, program, and project management services in various market sectors, including data centers, life sciences, and high-tech industries. With the addition of Linesight, IPS has over 3,000 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.
Specialties
Process Architecture, Process Design, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Qualification, LEAN Project Delivery, Strategic Master Planning, Energy Conservation Management, Project Controls, Program/Project Management, Operations/Logistics Strategy and Planning, EPCMV and Staffing Services.

IPS is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer.

Regardless of past practice, all resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at IPS via email, the Internet, or directly to hiring managers at IPS in any form without a valid written search agreement in place for a specific position will be deemed the sole property of IPS, and no fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by IPS as a result of the referral or through other means.

• Specific systems experienced preferred within Microsoft suite of applications, ERP systems (SAP, JDE, etc) and Hyperion Essbase (or equivalents)
• Working Manufacturing experience preferred
• English - desirable

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. Our CX Quality team, part of CX Enablement, works to constantly elevate the overall customer experience by ensuring consistently high-quality interactions across all channels. We achieve this by meticulously monitoring external customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT) and internal agent performance, providing actionable, data-driven insights to empower CX leadership, optimize operational processes, and continuously refine our quality assurance efforts for scalable growth.
This team should provide insights and recommendations to CX leadership and also other internal areas, leading actionable plans to improve customer experience towards excellence.

  • Team Development: Manage and develop a team of CX Quality analysts & coordinators, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive CX quality strategy aligned with overall business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Quality Program Management: Design, implement, and manage robust quality assurance programs to guarantee continuous quality monitoring for all customer-facing operations (internal teams and third parties BPOs).
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for CX quality. Regularly monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance, identifying trends, root causes of issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocate: Partner with CX and other support teams to integrate customer feedback into quality processes, ensuring insights drive continuous improvement.
  • Coaching & Training Support: Collaborate with training and CX operations teams to develop and deliver targeted coaching, training materials, and best practices based on quality findings to enhance agent performance and customer interactions.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Collaborate with other teams to identify and optimize inefficient or ineffective customer journeys and internal processes that impact CX quality. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and new technologies optimization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

title: Solution/Product Manager ( (SAP Sales & Distribution)) Information Technology
description:
Job Reference JR0085800

Professional Areas Information Technology

Louis Dreyfus Company is a world leader in the processing of agricultural products & the merchandising of a diverse range of commodities. Founded & based in Europe, Louis Dreyfus Company enjoys strong regional presence in North & South America, Europe, Asia, Middle East & Africa.


To support its growing needs, Louis Dreyfus Company has launched a global ERP program named BOLD – BackOffice Louis Dreyfus and based on SAP S4Hana solution. This ERP program covers the following supply chain processes:
- Procurement processes supported by SAP MM connected to ARIBA solution and FIORI user interface.
- Commodities & non-commodities inventory management supported by SAP MM.
- Equipment repair & maintenance supported by SAP PM.
- Production Planning & Execution supported by SAP PP.
- Quality inspection process supported by SAP QM.
- Sales & distribution process supported by SAP SD.
- Transportation management supported by SAP TM.


In this context of multi-year global ERP programs, Louis Dreyfus is in search of SAP Sales & Distribution Solution Manager to support the rollout in Brazil which is one of the largest LDC scopes.


While developing skills related to LDC’s sales & distribution business process in S/4 Hana solution, you will have the possibility to become a change agent and play a key role on our ambitious SAP Program.


We invite you to join our team if you strive to make a difference with your contribution & establish yourself as an inspiring member of our DT&A organization.

Job Description

As a Sr. Solution Specialist, you are the referent for the SAP sales and distribution solution.
You define and establish target solution, starting from an initial conceptual vision and evolving into a more concrete solution specification. You make high-level design choices according to the business strategy; dictate the standards, guidelines, best practices, and patterns and identify impacts on the information system. You will have to understand business requirements, prepare or review specifications, work effectively with other functional and technical team members, make recommendations, and converge all requirements into one/several solutions.
When specifications are set and solutions defined, you will also ensure the delivery of the solution hand-in-hand with the rest of the team.


In this position, you will have three main roles covering a large scope of responsibilities:
You are the gatekeeper of the sales & distribution processes and it integration with the rest of the ecosystem :
• Understand the business needs and translate into a solution.
• With other team members, you design cross processes flows.
• Work closely and confidently with various departments.
• You are ensuring maintenance and enhancement of your process.
You act as trusted partner for long term & continuous improvement:
• Manage business relationship to define target priorities and business value.
• Ensure communication and be responsible of oneself indicators (measurable KPIs).
• Animate, inform, communicate, enhance, anticipate and perform with the other domains to ensure end-to-end design.
• Elaborate action plans for continuous improvements of the solution and solving recurrent incidents.
You are part of the company that implements worldwide initiatives. You will be onboarded as project team member in S/4 worldwide roadmap.


As a summary:
You will have a full view of what is done in our team :
• You will be responsible of SAP Sales & Distribution processes, including integration with the other flows.
• You will be making solution design decisions as an owner of the SAP Sales & Distribution solution & processes.
• You will manage the business relationship to ensure priority and business value.
• You will enable long term value by proposing solution improvements.

Experience

6 years proven experience in large IT projects and in an international multi-cultural environment.

IT Skills
• Experience in IT best practices.
• Good experience in SAP SD.
• Basic experience in SAP TM.
• Basic experience in SAP Integration (IDoc, Web Service, etc.)
• Good experience in SAP Fiori.
• Basic experience with JIRA and ServiceNow.
• Good experience on full SAP rollout project lifecycle.

Business Skills
• Good source to contract and procure to pay business processes understanding.
• Basic experience in soft commodity trading practices.

Soft Skills
• Great relationship and ability to work with multiple teams.
• Ability and flexibility to work independently as well as in a team.
• Ability to learn fast and adapt to new solutions.
• Ability to demonstrate Critical Thinking.
• Strong analysis, synthesis & communication capacity (written & oral).
• Flexibility/adaptability in a quick changing background scenario & no uncomfortable feelings in front of ambiguity.
• Business customer focused and high proactivity.
• Analytical and problem-solving Skills
• Be fluent in English, written and spoken.
• Be able to work under pressure and tight deadlines.
